name: Barbarian: the client's Throw Weapon cast time includes the server's 500 ms ranged preparation (COA-5836)
contract: Throw Weapon (572614, 804136, 806876-806881) is a ranged-slot spell (Attributes 0x00010012,
SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT) with a thrown-weapon requirement and CastingTimeIndex 5 (2000 ms).
SpellInfo::CalcCastTime adds 500 ms to every ranged-slot spell that is not an auto repeat, so the server casts
it in 2500 ms while the client's tooltip and cast bar used the 2000 ms row: the client finished its cast bar
half a second before the server, which players saw as a slow cast that does not match its tooltip and as a
second global cooldown. As for the Witch Doctor ranged-slot abilities (#7167), the server now streams a
Spell.dbc row whose CastingTimeIndex points at the 2500 ms row, so both sides agree. The server's own
